events.name: Detroit Tigers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Sean Burke pitched six effective innings, Miguel Vargas homered and the Chicago White Sox topped the Detroit Tigers 3-1 on Saturday for a sorely needed victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sean Burke and Miguel Vargas help the White Sox beat the Tigers 3-1

headlines.description: — The Milwaukee Brewers tied a team record with their 97th win of the season, beating Baltimore 1-0 Saturday with the help of a fly ball lost in the sun by Orioles right fielder Rece Hinds.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers tie team record with 97th win, beat Orioles 1-0 with help of fly ball lost in sun

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Richie Palacios dropped a fly ball into shallow right in the ninth inning to score Junior Caminero and give the Tampa Bay Rays a 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palacios has RBI single in the 9th to give the Rays a 2-1 victory over the Red Sox

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Carson Benge had three hits to break Pete Alonso's Mets season rookie record, homering along with Francisco Alvarez as New York again prevented the Philadelphia Phillies from gaining ground in the NL wild card race with a 10-3 win Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Benge breaks Mets rookie hits record held by Alonso in New York's 10-3 win over Phillies

headlines.description: — Angel Martínez homered from both sides of the plate as part of his second career four-hit game, Chase DeLauter had a three-run homer, and the Cleveland Guardians remained in first place in the AL Central with a 12-6 victory over the Athletics on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Martínez homers from both sides of the plate as Guardians beat Athletics to stay atop AL Central

headlines.description: — Matthew Boyd ended a six-start winless streak, Dansby Swanson hit his first home run since coming off the injured list and the Chicago Cubs moved closer to their second straight playoff berth by beating the Cincinnati Reds 5-2 Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Boyd ends 6-start winless streak, Cubs beat Reds 5-2 to close on playoff berth

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Brandon Lowe hit a go-ahead two-run homer in the eighth to lift the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 6-5 victory over the Kansas City Royals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brandon Lowe's go-ahead homer in the 8th lifts the Pirates past the Royals, 6-5

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Five relievers held Toronto to six hits after Cal Quantrill left 12 pitches in because of right lat tightness, and the Rangers moved into sole possession of the AL West lead for the first time since late August with a 6-2 win over the Blue Jays on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers take sole possession of AL West lead, Quantrill leaves with injury in 6-3 win over Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Ronald Acuña Jr. hit a go-ahead grand slam in the seventh inning, and the Atlanta Braves beat Houston 6-3 Saturday night to drop the Astros out of the AL West lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Acuña grand slam leads Braves to 6-3 win, dropping Astros from AL West lead

events.name: Washington Nationals at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Washington successfully challenged for catcher’s interference with the bases loaded in a four-run 11th inning in the Nationals' 8-5 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nationals score 4 runs in 11th in an 8-5 victory over the Cardinals

headlines.description: — Cole Carrigg hit a go-ahead two-run single during a four-run seventh inning, lifting the Colorado Rockies to a 5-3 win over Seattle on Saturday night and moving the Mariners to the brink of elimination.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carrigg's 2-run single in 7th lifts Rockies to 5-3 win, moving Mariners to verge of elimination

events.name: New York Yankees at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Pavin Smith hit a two-run homer in the ninth inning to lift the Arizona Diamondbacks over the New York Yankees 5-3 on Saturday night, giving the D-backs' slim playoff hopes a boost.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pavin Smith's 2-run, game-winning homer lifts D-backs over Yankees 5-3, helps slim playoff hopes

events.name: Miami Marlins at San Diego Padres

leaders.displayValue: 1-4, HR, 2 RBI, R, 2 BB, SB, K

headlines.description: — Rookie Ethan Salas singled in Jake Cronenworth from third base with one out in the 10th inning and the San Diego Padres beat the Miami Marlins 7-6 on Saturday night to lower their magic number to three for clinching their third straight postseason...
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Salas has walk-off single in 10th as Padres beat Marlins 7-6, reduce magic number to 3

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Mookie Betts went 4 for 4 with three doubles, Will Smith added three hits including a home run, and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the San Francisco Giants 10-4 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dodgers outslug Giants 10-4, led by Mookie Betts with four hits

headlines.description: — Christian Moore hit an infield single with two outs and the bases loaded that bounded off reliever Taylor Rogers' leg to score Zach Neto and give the Los Angeles Angels a 6-5, 11-inning victory over the Minnesota Twins on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Angels beat Twins 6-5 in 11 innings on Moore's bases-loaded, 2-out infield single
